title: Bind admin endpoint to loopback-only by default
description:
Change the default admin.addr from '0.0.0.0:9090' to '127.0.0.1:9090' in both example configs. Add a startup warning if admin.addr is bound to a non-loopback address without authentication configured. Artifact: updated config.example.toml for both transit and reader, startup validation in main.rs.

Acceptance: default config binds admin to 127.0.0.1; warning emitted if non-loopback + no auth; warning is suppressible via explicit config flag; unit test: non-loopback without auth emits warning
